scientific_integrity: One theorem with its exact cycle-composition coefficient formula, analytic weighted asymptotics, and Gaussian intrinsic-volume index profile. No new claim of the general zonotope wedge formula. Numerical tests are separate from the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the canonical unscaled cycle graphical zonotope and fixed positive weights. The known zonotope wedge-volume formula is credited to the literature. The Gaussian conclusion has not received independent review; priority over inaccessible or unindexed sources is not certified. Finite checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Gaussian intrinsic-volume profiles for cycle graphical zonotopes
